channel.title: Antenne: Neorgon fleet news
channel.description: Launches, features, and fixes across the Neorgon fleet, approved at the desk before publishing

item.title: Three sites, one way to sign in
item.description: Meme Vault, BuyHacks and Character Sheet now share one sign-in: one Neorgon account, and one dialog in each site's name and colours. A signed-out visitor loads nothing from the sign-in service until that dialog opens.

item.title: What you miss today is a card tomorrow
item.description: Runcible turns every wrong answer in a Quiz round into a Rappel card, in a personal deck that appears on Today as soon as it has one.

item.title: Two shelves arrive: Vitrina and Bouquin
item.description: Vitrina shows your science fiction paperbacks by their spines. Bouquin tracks the books r/suggestmeabook keeps recommending.

item.title: The Japanese Book grows to fourteen chapters
item.description: Six new chapters land in Runcible: the writing system, phrases by situation, graded reading, the rest of the grade-two kanji, register, and handwriting with a tracing pad.

item.title: Quiz learns rows, Spanish, and an optional clock
item.description: A round can now be one row of a kana table or one group of words, every gloss reads in Spanish, and a clock is there for anyone who asks for it.

item.title: Runcible, Rappel and Quiz open on the same afternoon
item.description: The three learning sites announced last week are live: a book that teaches back, a spaced repetition engine, and four small games that explain every miss.

item.title: Space scrolls again on every keyboard-kit site
item.description: The shared keys kit cancelled a bound key before asking whether the site wanted it, so Space could not scroll a page or press a focused button. It asks first now.

item.title: Mosaic crops, and turns without leaking the background
item.description: The editor gains a crop, and a rotated tile no longer shows the canvas behind it.

item.title: Every site is installable again
item.description: The web manifests gained a start URL and a scope, so the browser's install prompt works fleet-wide, and the header mark was re-stamped on the way.

item.title: Three more on the way: Runcible, Rappel and Quiz
item.description: Three learning tools are registered and being built. Runcible teaches a subject chapter by chapter, Rappel drills flashcards with spaced repetition, and Quiz is small games that teach one thing at a time. None is open yet.

item.title: The dash hunt learns to read code
item.description: The tool that keeps a certain punctuation mark out of the fleet's writing now understands JavaScript well enough to tell a comment from a string, including inside nested template literals.

item.title: One set of keyboard shortcuts, everywhere
item.description: Press ? on any Neorgon site and the same help sheet appears, built from that site's own list of shortcuts. 53 sites now share it, and every single-key binding can be switched off or remapped.

item.title: Aficion learns your ties
item.description: The atlas grows to 331 nodes and 22 clusters, levels become one Low-to-Hardcore dedication scale, and you can now tie your own links between nodes, note why, and link straight to any node.

item.title: Aficion opens the atlas
item.description: One connected map of 269 hobbies and the crafts underneath, drawn like a skill tree: mark what you practise, watch the gold paths join, and compare maps by link.

item.title: Every site gets one way home
item.description: The logo and the site title merged into a single link home, the favicon now takes its tint from whatever theme you picked, and the hub has its own planet icon in the header.

item.title: Echeance watches the clock
item.description: Echeance tracks when tokens and credentials expire, and what the renewal actually takes for each one. The renewal steps live next to the date, because the date alone never helped anybody.

item.title: Balise collects the corrections
item.description: Spotted something wrong on a Neorgon site? Balise takes the report. It collects corrections raised from anywhere in the fleet, triages them behind a private desk, and keeps a public record of what got fixed.

item.title: Four sites open in one day
item.description: Releve, Scalpel, Enjeu and Cadrage all went live on the same day. A transcript pricer, a skill dissector, a print-and-play boss rush, and a camera settings trainer.

item.title: Resume Forge opens its second wave
item.description: The delivery board is open again: Resume Forge is getting a second campaign, with contracts frozen and workstreams assigned.

item.title: Four sites take French names
item.description: Gambit is now Gamme, Stake is Enjeu, TickBox is Carnet, Rigcheck is Cadrage. One live domain moved, and the old one redirects.
